principle: Photography and video are documentary product content. Search from the exact person/event/place and authoritative source, assign each asset to a semantic slot, preserve provenance, and never replace missing real evidence with generated or unrelated stock media.
forbidden: AI-generated trainer, athlete, child, crowd, camp, venue or event photography presented as real
random stock used as a named federation/event/person/place
face or identity inference from appearance
image-search thumbnails or reposts treated as provenance
a catalog or mirror described as an official publisher
another event/year/place captioned as the target event
generic promotional filler used instead of factual captions
invented quotes, achievements, biographies or event stories
source_priority: Красный Плёс official site / official album for camp content
named photographer or directly connected publication with explicit binding
catalog/mirror only as discovery or secondary provenance evidence when its relationship is stated honestly
generic stock only for genuinely non-specific atmosphere

search_method.rule: Search engines and catalog mirrors discover the original source surface; neither becomes official authority merely because it indexes the content.
search_method.before_search: Define the media slot job first.
search_method.after_find: Record source page, publisher class, authority page when different, subject, date/context, identity status when relevant, crop intent and fallback.
search_method.promotion_gate: A discovered binary is not public-ready until the source relationship is strong enough for the claim made by its slot. Secondary mirrors may generate candidates, not automatic production media.

slots.job: Show real physical training/camp activity immediately, not a decorative river photograph.
slots.preferred_evidence: Official Красный Плёс training video or exact-event federation media.
slots.source_context: The official camp archive embeds VID_20260605_092450.mp4, VID_20260605_092455.mp4 and VID_20260605_092458.mp4 in the 2026 training-day material.
slots.crop: Full-bleed action; keep the active subject inside the central mobile-safe region.
slots.fallback: Intentional dark/typographic hero state; never a broken image or unrelated substitute.

slots.job: Document different classes of camp evidence rather than repeat one poster.

slots.identity_requirement: The source must explicitly bind the image to that exact person. An official profile/post is preferred; a mirror may support identity only when its non-official status is recorded and the official authority surface is also known.
slots.fallback: Typography/initials poster. No generic club photo may masquerade as a portrait.

slots.job: Show actual federation training, competition or instructional culture.
slots.notes: orgs.biz explicitly identifies itself as a catalog and says the information is reference-only, so it must not be described as the official federation website. It can help discover dated federation posts and userapi assets; final provenance should prefer the VK federation page, exact VK album/post, named photographer archive or another direct source.

copy_policy.rule: Use project data or source wording/facts. Do not invent emotional slogans to compensate for weak evidence, and do not upgrade a mirror/catalog into an official source by wording.
copy_policy.ui_microcopy_exception: Navigation, buttons and ordinary interface labels may be written normally as interface copy.

done_when: Every critical media slot has a semantic job and provenance.
Official, secondary and discovery sources are classified correctly.
Research candidates are not promoted before their required original-source gate passes.
No unrelated repeated poster substitutes for exact evidence.
Desktop/mobile crops preserve the evidence selected for each slot.
Critical remote media fails into intentional UI.
Rendered media can be traced back to its original or explicitly classified secondary source page.
